---
title: "Elections"
---

This project examines results from the November 3, 2026 North Carolina general election using official precinct-level data provided by the North Carolina State Board of Elections.

```{r}
#| echo: false
#| message: false
#| warning: false
library(tidyverse)
library(maps)

# Read the precinct-level results data
results <- read_tsv("results_pct_20261103.zip")

# Plot total votes for the US Senate race
results |>
  filter(`Contest Name` == "US SENATE") |>
  group_by(Choice, `Choice Party`) |>
  summarize(total_votes = sum(`Total Votes`), .groups = "drop") |>
  ggplot(aes(x = reorder(Choice, total_votes), y = total_votes, fill = `Choice Party`)) +
  geom_col() +
  coord_flip() +
  scale_y_continuous(labels = scales::comma) +
  labs(
    title = "North Carolina elections",
    subtitle = "2026 US Senate Race",
    x = "Candidate",
    y = "Total Votes",
    fill = "Party"
  ) +
  theme_minimal()
```

The chart above displays the total statewide votes cast in the 2026 U.S. Senate race, comparing results across all participating candidates and parties. In the interactive map below, hover over any precinct to see the percentage to which each party won.

```{r}
#| echo: false
#| message: false
#| warning: false
#| out-width: 100%
library(sf)
library(leaflet)

# Load North Carolina precinct boundaries
nc_precincts <- read_rds("nc_precincts.rds")

# Calculate precinct-level vote percentages
precinct_votes <- results |>
  filter(`Contest Name` == "US SENATE") |>
  group_by(County, Precinct) |>
  summarize(
    total_votes = sum(`Total Votes`),
    dem_votes = sum(`Total Votes`[`Choice Party` == "DEM"]),
    rep_votes = sum(`Total Votes`[`Choice Party` == "REP"]),
    .groups = "drop"
  ) |>
  mutate(
    pct_dem = if_else(total_votes > 0, round(100 * dem_votes / total_votes, 1), 0),
    pct_rep = if_else(total_votes > 0, round(100 * rep_votes / total_votes, 1), 0),
    diff = round(abs(pct_dem - pct_rep), 1),
    winner = case_when(
      dem_votes > rep_votes ~ "DEM",
      rep_votes > dem_votes ~ "REP",
      TRUE ~ "Tie"
    )
  )

# Join boundaries with vote percentages
precinct_map <- nc_precincts |>
  left_join(precinct_votes, by = c("county" = "County", "precinct" = "Precinct")) |>
  mutate(
    prec_label = if_else(!is.na(precinct_name) & precinct_name != "", paste0(precinct, " (", precinct_name, ")"), precinct),
    # Hover tooltip showing candidate percentages and the winning party margin
    hover_label = paste0(
      "<strong>", county, " County — Precinct ", prec_label, "</strong><br/>",
      "Democrat (Roy Cooper): ", pct_dem, "% (", scales::comma(dem_votes), " votes)<br/>",
      "Republican (Michael Whatley): ", pct_rep, "% (", scales::comma(rep_votes), " votes)<br/>",
      "<strong>Result: </strong>",
      case_when(
        dem_votes > rep_votes ~ paste0("DEM won by ", diff, "%"),
        rep_votes > dem_votes ~ paste0("REP won by ", diff, "%"),
        TRUE ~ "Tied"
      )
    )
  )

# Color palette for winning party
party_pal <- colorFactor(
  palette = c("DEM" = "#2E74C0", "REP" = "#CB454A", "Tie" = "#808080"),
  domain = precinct_map$winner
)

# Plot interactive precinct map with hover tooltips
leaflet(precinct_map, width = "100%", height = "650px") |>
  addProviderTiles(providers$CartoDB.Positron) |>
  addPolygons(
    fillColor = ~party_pal(winner),
    weight = 0.5,
    opacity = 1,
    color = "white",
    fillOpacity = 0.75,
    highlightOptions = highlightOptions(
      weight = 2,
      color = "#222222",
      fillOpacity = 0.95,
      bringToFront = TRUE
    ),
    label = ~lapply(hover_label, htmltools::HTML),
    labelOptions = labelOptions(
      style = list("font-weight" = "normal", padding = "4px 8px"),
      textsize = "13px",
      direction = "auto"
    )
  ) |>
  addLegend(
    pal = party_pal,
    values = precinct_map$winner,
    title = "Winning Party",
    position = "bottomright"
  )
```
